title: Stop guessing. Start calculating.
intro: The simulator does not start from the vague label of trader. It starts from asset, strategy, horizon, capital, and leverage, then cross-matches that combination with a real cost database.
step1_desc: Choose asset, holding horizon, and strategy. Available strategies change with the selected context.
step2_desc: The system applies real spreads, funding, TER, and commissions to the instruments and brokers that fit the combination.
step3_desc: See which broker and instrument combination is mathematically more efficient for your use case.
